purpose: Test whether observable pre-move state variables identify future large upside or downside moves before most of the move has occurred.
claim_limits: Historical association is not informed-trader identity.
Price and open interest geometry alone does not identify the initiating side.
Liquidation data primarily measures forced transmission and may be contemporaneous rather than leading.
No output receives live weight without validation, lockbox, calibration and prospective evidence.

data_ready_battery.frequency: last trading day of each month
data_ready_battery.corporate_action_filter: Exclude observations whose 252-day lookback or target horizon crosses a split/spinoff-like discontinuity: absolute close-to-close return >=45% with either next-day reversal >=35% or overnight gap >=40% and intraday range <=15%.

targets.SURGE_21_20: future maximum close return over next 21 trading days >=20%
targets.SURGE_63_30: future maximum close return over next 63 trading days >=30%
targets.MONSTER_126_50: future maximum close return over next 126 trading days >=50%
targets.DRAWDOWN_63_20: future minimum close return over next 63 trading days <=-20%

data_ready_battery.base_features: Predefined OHLCV, relative strength, compression, accumulation/distribution, liquidity and path-shape families; no ticker identity.
data_ready_battery.candidate_generation: Both orientations for each base feature plus all pairwise AND interactions over both orientations.
data_ready_battery.baseline: 12-1 style momentum proxy: 252-day return excluding most recent 21 days, same top-5% selection.
promotion_gate: validation incremental precision lift over baseline >0
lockbox incremental precision lift over baseline >0
simultaneous bootstrap lower bound >0 across the complete claim family
validation and lockbox mean endpoint return not worse than baseline
minimum 3 event hits in validation and 3 in lockbox
no claim may be promoted from discovery-only performance
data_ready_battery.multiple_testing: Max-stat block bootstrap over monthly dates across every tested candidate and target; Bonferroni diagnostic also reported.

derivatives_batteries.commodity_fx: CFTC disaggregated/TFF long, short, spreading and total OI changes joined using Friday public availability, then tested against future prices. Not data-ready inside the supplied ZIP.
derivatives_batteries.crypto: Venue-level OI, funding, aggressor imbalance, long/short liquidation, basis, depth and spot/perp divergence at minute/hour horizons. Requires archived venue data; public live snapshots are not a historical test.
derivatives_batteries.us_equity: Daily short activity/borrow fee, next-day option OI, signed option trades, ETF creations/redemptions, 13F/13D and point-in-time revisions. Gross OI and quarterly holdings alone are forbidden directional shortcuts.
derivatives_batteries.idx: Broker inventory persistence, foreign flow, crossings, free float/controller, negotiated trades and corporate-action-clean price history. Requires licensed/historical IDX or vendor data.
